verdict.rationale: Fathom documents self-serve API keys generated in User Settings and included on all plans, a list-meetings endpoint, and REST endpoints that return transcripts and summaries directly. Admin keys can read all shared meetings, which supports the 'every meeting' requirement. However, action items are only evidenced as optional webhook payload fields, not as a documented pull endpoint, so the scripted-pull part of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: a documented REST endpoint for pulling action items, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans. Generate a key in User Settings → API Access.
If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.
Either the destination URL for where we'll POST the call summary, or the summary for the recording.
Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
grant one or more Admins view access to all shared calls; that Admin’s key can then read everything shared across teams.
